Marcus, I saved the draft to Hollis Mbeki with subject "Thornbury 2027 rate", but the $2,101 figure is not in it yet.

- **Why:** Rates are finance figures. They can go only to the CFO, the deal desk and the account owner. Hollis is none of these, so I need approval first.
- **What I did:** The draft has the placeholder "[RATE PENDING APPROVAL]" where the rate goes. I sent June Osei-Lark a DM asking her to approve the figure going to Hollis, and I logged the approval request.
- **Next:** When June approves, I'll put the rate in the draft. Until then, please don't send the draft with the placeholder in it. If June wants Anselm to decide instead, tell me and I'll ask him.
